result.output:
# Tacto Negotiation Arena - starter kit

A Python client for the arena API, two example buyer agents that negotiate by e-mail, helpers that
read the suppliers' documents and price a term sheet, a runner that plays many cases in parallel,
`arena-sim` - a local simulator of the arena's API - and a read-only MCP server over the data
package. Read the brief first
(`../brief/brief.md`); the full API is in `../brief/api.md`. Code: MIT.

## Quickstart - first agent on the board in 15 minutes

You need Python 3.12 and [uv](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/).

**1. Get your team's key** (one per team): open `https://arena.tacto.ai/apply`, enter your team name and a
contact e-mail, and show the match code it displays at the Tacto desk. Once an organiser approves,
the key appears **once** on that page - copy it and press "Got the key". Only that page (or its
link) shows it; lost it → ask the organisers to reset it. Keep it out of git.

```bash
cd starter-kit
uv sync --all-extras            # 2. install
cp .env.example .env            # 3. put ARENA_URL and your key (ARENA_API_KEY) into .env
uv run arena me                 # 4. your team and its practice quota
uv run arena cases              # 5. the practice cases (the 10 hosted ones are playable)
uv run arena play case:P01 -v   # 6. the naive agent negotiates one case
uv run arena board              # 7. you are on the practice leaderboard
```

Is the arena up? `curl $ARENA_URL/health`.

Step 6 prints the deal, your total cost `c_deal` against `c_open` and `c_best`, the case score,
and a **replay link**: every e-mail and the supplier's reasons for each move, in words. That is
the learning loop - play a practice case, read the replay, improve your agent, play
again. In practice your best score per case counts, so play a case again whenever your agent improves.
**Quota:** 200 practice sessions per team per rolling 24 hours. `arena play` and `arena run` print
how many are left; `arena run` plays only the hosted practice cases and stops starting new ones
once the quota is used up (a `429` there does not go away by retrying). Plan your runs.

**Now the LLM agent.** Download the data (`ARENA_DATA=data/package` in `.env`), choose a model in
`.env` (your own key), then:

```bash
uv run arena data                                          # unpacks data/package (and the Sunday release once public)
uv run arena play case:P01 --agent llm -v
uv run arena run --set practice --agent llm --parallel 8   # every hosted practice case, 8 at a time
uv run arena play case:D02 -v                              # the sandbox: 3 demo suppliers, no board
```

**Sunday 08:00:** run `arena data` again - it adds `data/release-sunday` (new news, letters, a
memo). `DataPackage` merges its facts and documents automatically; hidden cases may cite them.

**Master data file:** convert the downloaded package (and an available Sunday release) into one
`master.json` with:

```bash
uv run arena-build-master-data data/package
```

`DataPackage` reads that JSON for lookups, documents, cases and negotiation dossiers. It refreshes
the file automatically when source files change. Its general `query()` method creates a temporary,
read-only in-memory SQLite view from the JSON rows; it does not reopen the source database.

## Hello World (local, 3 commands)

No key yet? Play a whole case against the local simulator - no network, no quota, no LLM costs.
The simulator's supplier is a plain script; the real ones are on arena.tacto.ai. After
`uv sync --all-extras` (step 2 above):

```bash
# terminal 1: the simulator (--data is optional: leave it out until you have run `arena data`)
uv run arena-sim serve --no-clock --data data/package
# terminal 2: a simulator key, then the naive agent plays case:S01
ARENA_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8000 uv run arena register "Hello World" sim                  # prints an api_key
ARENA_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8000 ARENA_API_KEY=<the api_key> uv run arena play case:S01 -v
```

It prints the deal, `c_deal` against `c_open` and `c_best`, the score and a replay link - open it
in your browser: the result on top, then every e-mail of the negotiation.

## SpecAgent requirements and rehearsals

`--agent spec` uses code for prices, term sheets and closing decisions, with the configured model
for supplier profiles, extraction and wording. See [DESIGN_NOTES.md](DESIGN_NOTES.md) for precedence
choices and explicit deviations, and [FINAL_REPORT.md](FINAL_REPORT.md) for tests, scores and remaining
acceptance gaps.

```bash
uv run pytest -q
uv run ruff check arena_kit tests
uv run python -m arena_kit.spec.evaluate --set sandbox --out runs/my-sandbox
uv run python -m arena_kit.spec.evaluate --sim --out runs/my-sim
uv run python -m arena_kit.spec.evaluate --set practice --parallel 5 --out runs/my-practice
```

Each output directory must be new. Evaluations retain exact scores, sessions, threads, model
prompts/replies, source fingerprints and timeout/claim audits. Hosted practice consumes your arena
quota; model-enabled runs send the fictional case material to your configured provider and consume
model credits. Add `--no-model` for the code-only fallback benchmark, or `--ids P05` for a targeted
retest. Do not publish logs if you later use this agent with real confidential business data.

## Try it by hand (Postman, curl)

Feel the API before you put a model in front of it. On the real arena (practice and sandbox) the
60-second rule applies: three late replies in a row end the thread - too fast for typing. **By
hand, use the simulator first**, without the clock:

```bash
uv run arena-sim serve --no-clock --data data/package           # data/package from `arena data`; --data is optional
ARENA_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8000 uv run arena register "Team Name" sim   # prints a simulator api_key
export SIM=http://127.0.0.1:8000 KEY=<the api_key>
```

Every call sends `X-API-Key: <key>`; every `POST` also `Content-Type: application/json` and a
fresh `X-Move-Id` (any unique string - the same id again returns the same answer). In Postman:
those headers, the body as raw JSON.

```bash
# 1. the cases: case:S01 has one supplier, sup:70270, and the negotiable fields unit_price, payment_days
curl -s "$SIM/v1/cases?set=practice" -H "X-API-Key: $KEY"

# 2. open a session: the reply carries session_id (sim1 on a fresh simulator) and each supplier's quote e-mail
curl -s -X POST "$SIM/v1/sessions" -H "X-API-Key: $KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "X-Move-Id: open-1" -d '{"case_id": "case:S01"}'

# 3. the supplier's opening e-mail: its term sheet (offer:70270-0) and the quote PDF to fetch
curl -s "$SIM/v1/sessions/sim1/threads/sup:70270" -H "X-API-Key: $KEY"

# 4. your e-mail with an offer: the reply is the supplier's answer (status, term_sheets, claim_results)
curl -s -X POST "$SIM/v1/sessions/sim1/threads/sup:70270/messages" -H "X-API-Key: $KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" -H "X-Move-Id: msg-1" \
  -d '{"message": {"subject": "Adapter piece HI", "body": "Thank you for your quote. We offer 15.50 EUR at 60 days.",
       "term_sheets": [{"terms": {"unit_price": 15.5, "payment_days": 60}}]}}'

# 5. read the reply in the thread, and the session state
curl -s "$SIM/v1/sessions/sim1/threads/sup:70270" -H "X-API-Key: $KEY"
curl -s "$SIM/v1/sessions/sim1" -H "X-API-Key: $KEY"
```

To close, send `{"message": {"action": {"type": "accept", "term_sheet_id": "offer:70270-1"}}}` (the
term sheet you take) or `{"message": {"action": {"type": "walk_away"}}}` to the same `messages` path;
the answer carries the result and score. The quote PDF: `GET $SIM/v1/sessions/sim1/attachments/att:70270-0-quote`.
The same calls work on the arena (`https://arena.tacto.ai`, your team's key, a practice case) - with
the clock running.

## The Live Final: waves, in parallel, within the cap

The final comes in 5 themed waves. A wave holds several hidden cases that appear when the host
starts it; play them all in parallel (up to 10 open sessions per key). Each wave has a hard
cap - **8 minutes** (the host may extend one) - and what is still open then ends without a deal.
Start the runner before the first wave and leave it running:

----
# New buyer agent - requirements

What the next agent must do, taken from the three agents on `feature/team-agent` that hold the best
practice scores: `BuyerAgent` (`arena_kit/agents/buyer.py`, `arena_kit/strategy.py`,
`arena_kit/dossier.py`) for sections 1-10, `DualAgent` (`arena_kit/agents/dual.py`,
`arena_kit/intel.py`, `arena_kit/tactics.py`) for section 11, and `TeamAgent` (`team/agent.py`,
`team/levers.py`, `team/briefing.py`, `team/runner.py`, `team/final.py`; findings in `AGENTS.md`) for
section 12. Section 13 takes the MESO agent on this branch (`feature/meso-agent`:
`arena_kit/agents/llm.py`, `arena_kit/claims.py`, `arena_kit/writing.py`, `arena_kit/play.py`; run
logs in `runs/meso*/`). Each requirement is something that held up in the practice arena. Source
files in sections 1-12 refer to `feature/team-agent`.

## 0. What the agent is given: the case JSON

Everything the agent decides is computed from the case file (`POST /v1/sessions` → `case`, or
`GET /v1/cases?set=…`; the 19 practice files are in `data/practice_cases.json`) plus the suppliers'
opening quotes. Read every value from the file - never hard-code one - but expect the shapes and
ranges below: they hold in all 19 practice cases, and anything outside them is a signal to log and
fall back to defaults, not to crash. Source: `brief/api.md` (Case file, Terms, Cost and score).

### 0.1 A real case file (`case:P01`)

```json
{
  "case_id": "case:P01", "set": "practice", "type": "price_increase", "hosted": true,
  "title": "Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings",
  "briefing": "You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG. ... Need: 8150 pc a year. Category goal: stabilise a strategic supply ... Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200001. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.",
  "trigger_doc": "doc:20260911-70110-P01",
  "parts": ["part:310010"],
  "suppliers": ["sup:70110"],
  "negotiable": ["unit_price", "effective_date", "payment_days"],
  "fixed_terms": {"lead_time_days": 42, "volume_per_year": 8150, "contract_months": 12,
                  "index_clause": null, "incoterm": "FCA", "tooling_eur": 0},
  "term_options": {"effective_date": ["2026-11-01", "2027-01-01", "2027-04-01"],
                   "payment_days": [14, 30, 45, 60, 90]},
  "buyer": {
    "need_per_year": 8150, "horizon_years": 1.0,
    "current_unit_price": 126.53, "fallback_unit_price": 136.65,
    "interest_rate": 0.08, "reference_payment_days": 60,
    "need_lead_time_days": 45, "late_cost_per_day": 420, "cost_per_defect": 216,
    "category_goal": "stabilise",
    "fallback_risk_pct": 10, "index_risk_pct": 4,
    "sustainable_margin_pct": 3, "relationship_eur_per_point": 15470,
    "freight_eur_per_unit": {"EXW": 2.19, "FCA": 1.9, "DAP": 0.0},
    "index_paths": {},
    "must_haves": [],
    "alternative": {"kind": "quote", "ref": "quote:7200001",
                    "terms": {"unit_price": 143.22, "payment_days": 60, "lead_time_days": 70,
                              "volume_per_year": 8150, "contract_months": 12,
                              "effective_date": "2027-01-01", "index_clause": null,
                              "incoterm": "FCA", "tooling_eur": 1500, "ppm_commitment": 2376}}
  },
  "round_limit": 10,
  "refs": ["doc:20260911-70110-P01", "ctr:4600070110", "sc:70110@2026Q3", "quote:7200001"]
}
```

### 0.2 Top-level fields: what to expect, what uses it

| Field | Expect | Used by |
|---|---|---|
| `case_id`, `set` | `case:P01`…`P19` (practice), `case:D01`/`D02` (sandbox), hidden IDs in `final` | cache keys (R13.17), logs |
| `hosted` | practice only; `true` on the 10 playable cases (P01-P05, P07, P08, P10, P11, P18) | - |
| `type` | `price_increase`, `renewal`, `rfq`, `bundling`, `raw_material`, `capacity`, `quality` | `TYPE_LEVERS` (R1.5), case questions (R9.4), anchor (R4.1, R13.12) |
| `title`, `briefing` | prose; repeats need, goal, need lead time, fallback and must-haves in words. The structured `buyer` block is the source of truth - never parse numbers from the briefing | profile prompt (R1.3), writer context (R9.2) |
| `trigger_doc` | a `doc:` ID (the supplier's letter / RFQ document) | data arguments - notice vs contract (R13.9) |
| `parts` | 1 part, except bundling (P07: 4, P15: 3) - still **one** `unit_price` per sheet | dossier (R1.1), should-cost (R2.1) |
| `suppliers` | 1 supplier; 2-3 = an RFQ (P05: 3, P06: 2; sandbox D02: 2) | RFQ handling (sections 8, 12.6) |
| `negotiable` | always contains `unit_price`, plus 2-3 of the fields below. A term sheet must carry **exactly** these fields or it is a `422` | sheets (R6, R11.11), lever table (R12.3) |
| `fixed_terms` | the case's other fields with their values (fields named in neither list - e.g. `ppm_commitment` outside quality cases - take the supplier's standard terms) | C computation, `describe` (R13.14) |
| `term_options` | allowed values per negotiable field except `unit_price` - send nothing else | lever table (R12.3), steps (R13.1), repair (R11.9) |
| `round_limit` | 10 in every case so far - read it, do not assume it | horizon H (R5.1), close rules (R7.5-R7.6) |
| `refs` | 3-5 starting IDs (`doc`, `ctr`, `sc`, `quote`); "a start, not the whole story" | dossier (R1.1), arguments (R9.5) |
| `facts` | **hidden cases only**: case-specific facts in `facts.json` format, citable in that case | merge into the claim data before computing arguments (R13.9) |
| `wave`, `theme`, `open`, `seconds_left` | **final only**; `seconds_left` until the 8-minute wave cap | case clock (R11.14-R11.16) - read `seconds_left`, don't assume 480 |

### 0.3 Negotiable fields and their options (all practice cases)

| Field | Options seen | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `unit_price` | free, EUR with 2 decimals | the only free field |
| `payment_days` | always `[14, 30, 45, 60, 90]` | reference is 60; fixed at 30-60 where not negotiable |
| `contract_months` | always `[12, 24, 36]` | with `horizon_years` = 2, 12 months leaves half the need uncovered (R12.2) |
| `volume_per_year` | three steps around the need, e.g. `[16379, 19890, 23400]` (≈ 70 / 85 / 100 % or 80 / 100 / 120 %) | where fixed it equals `need_per_year` |
| `effective_date` | `["2026-11-01", "2027-01-01", "2027-04-01"]` (price_increase) | the horizon starts at the earliest option; later = more units at `current_unit_price` |
| `lead_time_days` | 3-5 values, e.g. `[28, 35, 42, 56]` | compare with `need_lead_time_days`; often a must-have |
| `index_clause` | `null` + one series at deadband 0 / 3 / 5 %, fixed `material_share` (0.2-0.8) and `base_month` `"2026-08"` | the clause object must match an option exactly |
| `ppm_commitment` | `[300, 800, 1500, 2500]` (quality) | priced with `cost_per_defect` and the chargeback |
| `chargeback_eur_per_complaint` | `[0, 150, 300, 500]` (quality) | capped at `cost_per_defect` in C |
| `tooling_eur` | `[0, 7500, 15000]` (P06) | one-off, added to C |
| `incoterm` | `EXW` / `FCA` / `DAP`; fixed in every practice case | freight from `freight_eur_per_unit`; DAP is always 0.0 |

### 0.4 The `buyer` block: what to expect

| Field | Range seen | Pattern to rely on |
|---|---|---|
| `need_per_year` | 3,420 - 94,800 | units; with `horizon_years` the total need = N × H |
| `horizon_years` | `1` / `1.0` or `2` / `2.0` (API allows ≤ 3) | int **or** float - normalise; 1-year cases have `contract_months` fixed at 12 |
| `current_unit_price` | 4.20 - 412.74 | equals the fallback price in an RFQ (new part) |
| `fallback_unit_price` | 1.00 - 1.25 × current | 1.25 × in the capacity cases: walking is expensive |
| `interest_rate` | always 0.08 | our cost of money (R2.2) |
| `reference_payment_days` | always 60 | paying earlier than 60 days costs us interest |
| `need_lead_time_days`, `late_cost_per_day` | 5-59 days; EUR 40-2,400/day | capacity cases carry the high late cost |
| `cost_per_defect` | 0 - 780 | 0 in raw_material cases: ppm is worthless there |
| `category_goal` | `stabilise`, `secure_supply`, `quality_first`, `leverage`, `routine` | selects the playbook row (R13.10) and the anchor cut (R4.1) |
| `fallback_risk_pct` | follows the goal: leverage 3, routine 5, quality_first 8, stabilise 10, secure_supply 25 | uncovered need is the costliest mistake in secure_supply |
| `index_risk_pct` | follows the goal: leverage 1, routine / quality_first 2, secure_supply 3, stabilise 4 | a clause costs us this share of indexed spend on top of the path |
| `sustainable_margin_pct`, `relationship_eur_per_point` | 0.5-10 %; EUR 5,000-31,920 per point-year - **only** for stabilise and secure_supply, `null` otherwise | the margin charge (R2.3, R13.8); treat `null` as "no charge" |
| `freight_eur_per_unit` | `{EXW, FCA, DAP}`, DAP always 0.0 | per committed unit |
| `index_paths` | `{}` or one series: `AS-14404` +0.06, `CU-NOTATION` +0.05, `PPI-C241` +0.03 | the expected move of the clause's series; a series missing here has path 0 |
| `must_haves` | `[]` or one rule: `lead_time_days <= 42` (P05, P09), `<= 84` (P06), `volume_per_year >= 22230` (P10), `ppm_commitment <= 1500` (P11) | a deal that breaks one scores **0** - check every sheet and every accept against them (R6.7, R11.9) |
| `alternative` | `kind` = `quote` (`ref` = `quote:72000NN`, full `terms`), `current_contract` (`ref` = a `ctr:` ID **or `null`**, full `terms`), or `none` (`ref` null, `terms` `{}`) | C_alt = C(alternative terms); with `none`, no deal = uncovered need at the fallback price, score 0 |

### 0.5 Case types as they appear

| Type | Goals seen | Negotiable besides price | Typical must-have / alternative |
|---|---|---|---|
| `price_increase` | stabilise, leverage | effective_date, payment_days, index_clause or volume | quote or none |
| `renewal` | stabilise, routine | payment_days, contract_months, volume, index_clause | quote or none; H = 2 |
| `rfq` | leverage, stabilise | payment_days, lead_time_days, tooling_eur | lead-time must-have; `alternative: none` |
| `bundling` | routine | payment_days, contract_months | `current_contract`; 3-4 parts, one price |
| `raw_material` | leverage | index_clause, payment_days, contract_months | quote; `index_paths` set; `cost_per_defect` 0 |
| `capacity` | secure_supply | volume_per_year, lead_time_days, contract_months / payment_days | volume or lead-time must-have; fallback 1.25 × |
| `quality` | quality_first | ppm_commitment, chargeback, (lead_time_days) | ppm must-have or `current_contract` |

A hidden case may combine these differently or bring a new type: take the levers from `negotiable`
when `type` is unknown, and the `routine` playbook row when `category_goal` is unknown.

### 0.6 The opening quotes and the replies

`POST /v1/sessions` also returns `opening`, one entry per supplier:

```json
"sup:70240": {"offer_id": "offer:70240-0", "round": 0, "status": "open",
              "terms": {"unit_price": 31.5, "lead_time_days": 52},
              "alternatives": [],
              "missing_fields": ["payment_days"],
              "claims": [], "claim_results": [],
              "signals": {"reply_delay_days": 4, "validity_days": 30},
              "text": "Hello, Thank you for your enquiry. ..."}
```

- **`terms` can be partial.** Fields in `missing_fields` close on the supplier's **standard terms**
  (in the quote PDF) - fill them from the PDF before computing C; never assume our reference values.
- **An opening quote can break a must-have** (P05: 52 days against `<= 42`) - repair it (R11.9).
- `alternatives`: `[{offer_id, terms}]` - extra packages, acceptable like the main sheet (R12.11).
- Replies (`POST …/messages`) carry `status` (`open`, `final_offer`, `agreed`, `walked_away`,
  `no_bid`), `term_sheets` (its standing offer, `offer:` ID), `claim_results` per argument,
  `signals`, `missing_fields` and `attachments` (cost breakdown XLSX, 8D PDF, delivery schedule).

### 0.7 What to compute from the case JSON before the first message

1. Validate: every `negotiable` field except `unit_price` has `term_options`; no field is both
   fixed and negotiable; must-haves name real fields.
2. C(terms) with `arena_kit.total_cost`, the opening C of every supplier (standard terms filled),
   and C_alt from `buyer.alternative`.
3. Coverage: does `contract_months` × `volume_per_year` cover `need_per_year` × `horizon_years`?
   If an option closes the gap and lowers C, it goes into message 1 (R12.1-R12.2).

# SpecAgent design decisions

The implementation follows `NEW_AGENT_REQUIREMENTS.md`. This file collects choices previously
recorded only in docstrings and records how requirements that overlap are reconciled.
Code controls prices, term sheets, accept/walk decisions, claims and deadlines. The model profiles
suppliers, extracts what they said and writes the surrounding email text. Every model call has a
deadline and a code fallback.

## Rule precedence

| Overlap | Decision and reason |
|---|---|
| R4.1 vs R13.10 anchors | Use the deeper cut: leverage 15%, routine 10%, quality 8%, stabilise 6%, secure supply 5%; RFQs add 4 points. Apply the current-price/fair-price candidates and credibility limits afterwards. The relationship cost minimum is a floor, rather than an independent second anchor. |
| R5.2 reciprocity vs R12.5 15% steps | The 15% gap rule determines the planned step; reciprocity caps it when the supplier moved less. The 0.4% visible-step minimum wins over that cap, as R5.2 explicitly specifies. A nonmoving supplier gets one hold, then a real step. |
| R5.4 vs no retreat | Continue negotiating while a supplier is still moving, but do not ask below our previous target merely because the supplier improved. Supplier and alternative caps can still lower the target. |
| R6 menus vs R13.1 sequential terms | After coverage, heavy terms use a single-term equal-cost menu. Price rounds use the reference/give/decoy menu. A supplier ask may replace that menu with two clear trade packages. |
| R13.1 goal order vs R12.7 payment probe | A payment term worth stepping goes first, so the first menu also reveals payment preference. Remaining terms follow goal priority, then EUR weight; at most three terms. |
| R13.3 reopen vs R13.4 choice | A costly term gets at most one reopen. A menu with fewer than two credible packages is skipped and never recorded as a step or a lock. Its best value stays available in price rounds. |
| R13.5 revealed price vs an earlier menu lock | A supplier's own differently priced alternative overrides the earlier menu pick when its actual package costs us less. Persist that revealed value across replies without alternatives. Compare numeric terms by value, so `0` and `0.0` are the same lock. |
| R12.8 deadband vs R13.5 actual prices | New demanded-index menus use the supplier's own series and the cheapest deadband at equal unit price. Later supplier-priced alternatives are compared at their actual package costs; a cheaper zero-deadband package can win that revealed-price comparison. This can lose versus negotiating a wider band, and must be measured rather than assumed beneficial. |
| R12.12 final offer vs continued steps | A valid final offer closes at once. Only an unacceptable final gets one repair at its own price. Tone, walk risk and deadlock are never independent close rules. |
| R12.16 wait for rivals vs R13.16 60 seconds | Wait only until 45 seconds after the chosen supplier's reply, leaving 15 seconds to accept. A slow POST is polled from the thread after 3 seconds; waiting 70 seconds could itself exceed the reply clock. |
| R11.14 vs R11.15 clock | No new counter after 360 seconds, and no counter earlier if its estimated round cannot finish by 420. Writer time is also capped by that remaining round budget. Clock starts immediately after session open, before document reading/preparation. A shorter wave moves both marks earlier; zero seconds forces a close. |

## Cost estimates and prices

Supplier full cost comes from its breakdown, otherwise should-cost / 1.02, otherwise opening / 1.10.
For an RFQ whose bids are below should-cost, the lowest opening bid replaces stale should-cost as
the fallback estimate. Later concessions cannot disable the margin penalty: market calibration uses
opening bids, not the lowest price reached during negotiation. Only stabilise and secure-supply
goals include the supplier margin penalty.
The inherited implementation trusts only breakdown/should-cost estimates for the full-cost anchor
and credibility floor. With an opening-price-only estimate it uses the 75%-of-quote floor instead.
This is an additional deviation from literal R4.2/R6.5, which do not exempt an opening estimate;
retained as an explicit tuning decision, not silently described as full compliance.

A missing alternative (`kind: none`) leaves the accept ceiling infinite. A real alternative is
priced with its actual terms. Offers must beat it both with the estimated supplier penalty and
without it. Coverage is requested when it lowers cost; subsequent packages cannot reduce committed
coverage. Coverage repair can explicitly restore the full horizon and annual need.

Without a margin penalty, solve price from the linear cost function. With it, use golden-section
search for the cost minimum and bisection above that minimum. Prices must use two decimals, so the
literal R13.8 “within EUR 1” is often mathematically impossible: changing the price by EUR 0.01 on
189,600 units changes spend by EUR 1,896. Tests therefore use max(EUR 1, EUR 0.005 × committed units)
for rounding error. This is a documented deviation, not a claim of literal compliance.

A package need not have a lower unit price than the supplier's offer: a later effective date or
better payment terms can lower total cost despite a higher price. Credibility floors still apply.
When rounding near the convex cost minimum, use the first whole cent at or above that minimum.
Do not retain a gratuitous expedited lead time from the quote PDF: if an allowed normal lead time
still meets the need and must-haves at equal cost, request that instead. This addresses P05's explicit
overtime premium for 28 days when 35 days is sufficient; genuinely valuable speed is not relaxed.

## Evidence and wording

Practice ranges are warnings, not replacement values: a valid case with an unusual interest rate
must use that rate. Missing/invalid fields receive defensive defaults; every warning is logged.
Unknown case types use their actual negotiable fields; unknown goals use the routine playbook.
When a field is both fixed and negotiable in a malformed case, the negotiable definition wins and
the conflict is logged.

Prose alternatives inherit unchanged terms from the main offer before revealed prices are computed.
They cannot be accepted by an invented offer ID: packages found only in prose are offered back for
confirmation. An ambiguous index clause is skipped. Dates and all numeric leaves returned by the
analyst must occur in the supplier's text, and nonfinite figures are rejected.

Index arguments use two months of one series, twelve months apart, ending in the most recent
twelve-month window of the frozen September 2026 data. Missing endpoints or old windows produce no
claim. Positive changes are excluded unless below half the supplier's requested increase. Each data
ID counts once per case; rival quote/offer IDs count once per supplier. Hidden-case facts override
package facts and also participate in volatility checks. A series moving more than 15% is excluded
from offered index clauses.
Volatility uses unrounded endpoint values, unlike the one-decimal claim sentence: 15.04% is over
the risk threshold even though its printed claim would say 15.0%.

Code writes the options directly from the sheets, answers volume questions and inserts checked
claims. Lint drops leaking sentences, data IDs and unsupported figures, including small integers.
Personal salutations require a name in supplier emails; otherwise use the company name. Model
wording cannot introduce terms or change the action.

    return [f for f in case.get("negotiable", []) if f != "unit_price"]

"""Concessions: reciprocal, never stuck (section 5), with TeamAgent's step size (R12.5).

Everything is in C. Per thread a `Plan` keeps the anchor (fixed, R4.4; in an RFQ it may only fall,
R12.6), the target of every offer we made and the supplier's C after every reply (one entry per
reply, so a hold shows as a zero step).

  curve        our k-th offer closes 1 - (1 - k/H)^1.6 of the gap from the anchor to their C (R5.1)
  reciprocity  they moved more than MOVE_TOL of C: our step = max(min(planned, 0.5 x theirs), MIN_STEP
               of C) (R5.2); "planned" is at least BREAK_SHARE of the gap left (R12.5); when their step
               was larger than the gap left, we close MEET_SHARE of that gap
  deadlock     they did not move: hold ONCE, then one real step - at least BREAK_SHARE of the gap
               left and MIN_STEP of C (R5.3). Never two holds in a row, never a token step
  still moving their offer meets our target but they conceded more than MIN_STEP of C last round
               with more than 3 rounds left: target = their C - 0.5 x their step (R5.4)
  caps         never above CEILING x their C (R12.5), never above 0.995 x the alternative's C; in an
               RFQ at most 0.99 x the best rival's C and never below the anchor (R5.5)
"""

import math
from dataclasses import dataclass, field

MOVE_TOL = 0.001  # R5.2: a move under 0.1 % of C is no move
MIN_STEP = 0.004  # R5.2/R5.3: our smallest visible step, 0.4 % of C
RECIPROCITY = 0.5  # R5.2: we move by at most half of what they moved
BREAK_SHARE = 0.15  # R5.3/R12.5: a real step is at least 15 % of the gap left
CEILING = 0.997  # R12.5: never above 0.997 x their C
ALT_CAP = 0.995  # R5.5
RIVAL_CAP = 0.99  # R5.5
MEET_SHARE = 0.5  # it moved more than the gap left: we close this share of the gap


def curve(k, horizon):
    """Share of the gap conceded by our k-th offer (k = 0: the anchor)."""
    return 1 - (1 - min(k, horizon) / horizon) ** 1.6


@dataclass
class Plan:
    anchor: float | None = None  # in C
    targets: list = field(default_factory=list)  # the target C of every offer we made
    their_costs: list = field(default_factory=list)  # the supplier's C after every reply
    replies: int = 0
    holds: int = 0  # our holds in a row

    def observe(self, c_theirs, replies):
        """Record the supplier's C once per reply (a hold is a zero step)."""
        if replies > self.replies:
            self.their_costs.append(c_theirs)
            self.replies = replies

    def set_anchor(self, c_anchor, rfq=False):
        """Fixed once per thread (R4.4); in an RFQ it may only fall (R12.6)."""
        if self.anchor is None:
            self.anchor = c_anchor
        elif rfq:
            self.anchor = min(self.anchor, c_anchor)
        return self.anchor

    def their_step(self):
        """How far the supplier came toward us in its last reply, in C (0 for a hold)."""
        if len(self.their_costs) < 2:
            return 0.0
        return self.their_costs[-2] - self.their_costs[-1]

    def next_target(self, c_theirs, horizon, rounds_left=99, c_alt=float("inf"), rival_best=None, rfq=False):
        """The target C of our next offer and why: (target, info). Does not record it - `commit` does."""
        anchor = self.anchor if self.anchor is not None else c_theirs
        k = len(self.targets)
        planned = anchor + curve(k, horizon) * (c_theirs - anchor)
        step = self.their_step()
        moved = step > MOVE_TOL * c_theirs
        info = {"k": k, "their_step": step, "moved": moved, "kind": "anchor" if not k else None, "ours": None}
        if not k:
            target = planned
        else:
            prev = self.targets[-1]
            gap_left = max(0.0, c_theirs - prev)
            visible = MIN_STEP * c_theirs
            planned_step = max(planned - prev, BREAK_SHARE * gap_left)
            if moved:
                ours = max(min(planned_step, RECIPROCITY * step), visible)
                if step >= gap_left:
                    # it came further than what is left between us: meet it halfway, not a token step
                    # (P05: it dropped 30.50 -> 28.00, our 4-cent answer made it withdraw)
                    ours = max(ours, MEET_SHARE * gap_left)
                info["kind"] = "reciprocal"
            elif self.holds >= 1:
                ours = max(BREAK_SHARE * gap_left, visible)
                info["kind"] = "deadlock breaker"
            else:
                ours, info["kind"] = 0.0, "hold"
            target = prev + ours
            info["ours"] = ours
        info["still_moving"] = step > MIN_STEP * c_theirs
        if info["still_moving"] and target >= c_theirs and rounds_left > 3:
            # R5.4: still moving means ask again - but never for more than we last offered: going back
            # behind our own last offer reads as a retreat (judgement call, DESIGN_NOTES)
            target = max(c_theirs - 0.5 * step, self.targets[-1] if self.targets else -math.inf)
            info["kind"] = "still moving"
        target = min(target, CEILING * c_theirs, ALT_CAP * c_alt)
        if rfq and rival_best is not None:
            target = max(anchor, min(target, RIVAL_CAP * rival_best))
        return target, info

    def breaker(self, c_theirs):
        """The deadlock-breaking target (R5.3), when a hold would only repeat our last sheets (R13.7)."""
        prev = self.targets[-1] if self.targets else (self.anchor or c_theirs)
        ours = max(BREAK_SHARE * max(0.0, c_theirs - prev), MIN_STEP * c_theirs)
        return min(prev + ours, CEILING * c_theirs)

    def commit(self, target):
        """Record an offer we sent at `target`; a target equal to the last one is a hold."""
        hold = bool(self.targets) and target <= self.targets[-1] + 1e-6
        self.holds = self.holds + 1 if hold else 0
        self.targets.append(target)
"""R13.8: the unit price at which a package costs exactly a target C.

Without the supplier's margin charge C is linear in the price: p = (target - C(0)) / (C(1) - C(0)).
With it, C is convex in the price - falling down to the cheapest price, rising below it (a squeezed
supplier costs more than the price saves). The cheapest price is found by golden-section search
between 0.5x and 1.5x the supplier's price, and the target is solved by bisection on the side ABOVE
it: a price below the cheapest one costs more and leaves the supplier weaker.

Prices are whole cents, so a package's C can miss the target by up to half a cent per committed
unit (P08: 189,600 units, up to EUR 948); `tolerance` gives that bound.
"""

import math

from ..cost import total_cost
from .terms import committed_units

GOLDEN = (5**0.5 - 1) / 2


def _c(case, terms, std, supplier, p):
    return total_cost(case, {**terms, "unit_price": p}, std, supplier)


def tolerance(case, terms, std=None):
    """How close to a target C a whole-cent price can get: EUR 1, or half a cent per unit."""
    return max(1.0, 0.005 * committed_units(case, terms, std))


def cheapest_price(case, terms, std, supplier, hint):
    """The price at which these terms cost us least once the margin charge counts (C is convex in
    the price): golden-section search between 0.5x and 1.5x `hint`."""
    if supplier is None:
        return 0.5 * hint
    lo, hi = 0.5 * hint, 1.5 * hint
    for _ in range(80):
        a, b = hi - GOLDEN * (hi - lo), lo + GOLDEN * (hi - lo)
        if _c(case, terms, std, supplier, a) <= _c(case, terms, std, supplier, b):
            hi = b
        else:
            lo = a
    return (lo + hi) / 2


def price_for(case, terms, std, target, supplier=None, hint=None, slack=0.0):
    """The whole-cent unit price at which `terms` cost `target`, or None if no price does.
    `hint`: the supplier's price (the search window with a margin charge). `slack`: a structure whose
    cheapest C misses the target by at most this share is priced at its cheapest price instead (a menu
    keeps its 90-day option when the margin charge puts that structure's minimum just above target)."""
    if supplier is None:
        c0 = _c(case, terms, std, None, 0.0)
        c1 = _c(case, terms, std, None, 1.0)
        if not (math.isfinite(c0) and math.isfinite(c1)) or c1 <= c0:
            return None
        p = (target - c0) / (c1 - c0)
        return round(p, 2) if p > 0 else None
    hint = hint or terms.get("unit_price") or 1.0
    low = cheapest_price(case, terms, std, supplier, hint)
    c_low = _c(case, terms, std, supplier, low)
    if c_low > target + tolerance(case, terms, std):
        if slack and c_low <= target * (1 + slack):
            return round(math.ceil(low * 100) / 100, 2)
        return None  # out of reach: even the cheapest price costs more
    high = 1.5 * hint
    if _c(case, terms, std, supplier, high) <= target:
        return round(high, 2)
    for _ in range(60):
        mid = (low + high) / 2
        if _c(case, terms, std, supplier, mid) < target:
            low = mid
        else:
            high = mid
    p = round((low + high) / 2, 2)
    # whole cents: take the cent closer to the target, never one below the cheapest price
    best = min((p - 0.01, p, p + 0.01), key=lambda q: abs(_c(case, terms, std, supplier, q) - target))
    minimum_cent = math.ceil(cheapest_price(case, terms, std, supplier, hint) * 100) / 100
    return round(max(best, minimum_cent), 2)


def c_min_price(case, terms, std, supplier, lo, hi):
    """The price in [lo, hi] at which `terms` cost us least (with a margin charge the bottom of the
    convex curve; without one, `lo`) - R4.2: never anchor under the price at which C stops falling."""
    if supplier is None:
        return lo
    p = cheapest_price(case, terms, std, supplier, (lo + hi) / 2 if hi > lo else hi)
    return min(max(p, lo), hi)

316	    def decide(self, case, threads, sid=None, use_model=True):
317	        if case.get("case_id") != self.case_id:
318	            self.prepare(case, threads)
319	        live = live_threads(threads)
320	        if sid is None:  # the kit's sequential loop: the thread whose offer costs least
321	            sid = min(live, key=lambda s: self.standing_cost(case, threads, s))
322	        if sid not in live:
323	            return {"supplier_id": sid, "idle": True}
324	        th = self.t[sid]
325	        th.analyst.observe(threads[sid])
326	        first_rfq = len(self.case["suppliers"]) > 1 and not any(m.get("from") == "buyer" for m in threads[sid])
327	        terminal = latest(threads[sid]).get("status") in ("agreed", "final_offer")
328	        if use_model and self.analyst_complete is not None and not first_rfq and not terminal:
329	            # R11.3: a short grace; R12.14 first RFQ / R13.16 terminal offers go straight to code.
330	            since = time.monotonic() - self.reply_at.get(sid, time.monotonic())
331	            th.analyst.wait(min(GRACE_S, max(0.0, clock_mod.MODEL_WINDOW_S - since - 25)))
332	        with self.lock:
333	            states, views = self.views(threads)
334	            st = states[sid]
335	            close = closing.decide(views, sid, must_close=self.clock.must_close())
336	            if close is None and not self.clock.can_counter():
337	                close = self.late(states, views, sid)
338	            if close is not None:
339	                d = self.realise(close, states, threads, sid)
340	                if d is not None:
341	                    self.record("close", sid=sid, kind=close.kind, reason=close.reason, sheet=close.sheet_id,
342	                                elapsed=round(self.clock.elapsed(), 1))  # fmt: skip
343	                    return d
344	            if st.get("target") is None:  # no price on the table: ask for one
345	                return self.plain_message(threads, sid, [], "Could you please send us your offer with a unit price?")
346	            move = self.plan_move(states, views, threads, sid)
347	            if move is None or "sheets" not in move:  # a close, an offer-back or nothing left to send
348	                return move or {"supplier_id": sid, "idle": True}
349	        return self.write(states, threads, sid, move, use_model)

351	    def late(self, states, views, sid):
352	        """R11.16, after NO_NEW_COUNTER_AT: lock in a better prose offer if a round still fits; repeat our
353	        last offer only when nothing on the table is acceptable yet; otherwise close by R7."""
354	        fits = self.clock.round_fits()
355	        st, th = states[sid], self.t[sid]
356	        lock = self.lock_in(st)
357	        best_rows = [r for v in views.values() for r in v.rows if r.valid]
358	        if fits and lock and (not best_rows or lock[1] < min(r.c for r in best_rows) - 0.01) and "lock" not in th.flags:
359	            return closing.Close("lock_in", "late: lock in its prose offer", sid, terms=lock[0])
360	        if fits and not closing.ladder(views) and th.last_sheets and st["left"] > 1:
361	            return closing.Close("repeat", "late: nothing acceptable yet - our last offer again", sid)
362	        return closing.accept(views, "late: no new counter-offers") or closing.Close("idle", "late, nothing yet", sid)

364	    def lock_in(self, st):
365	        """R11.8: the supplier's best offer stated only in prose, if it keeps the must-haves, beats the
366	        alternative and is cheaper than its standing sheet: (terms, C) or None."""
367	        if st.get("best") is None:
368	            return None
369	        ctx, best = st["ctx"], None
370	        for po in st["intel"].prose_offers:
371	            if po.get("in_sheet"):
372	                continue
373	            t = complete(self.case, po["terms"], st["std"])
374	            if not t.get("unit_price") or not ctx.ok(t):
375	                continue
376	            c = ctx.c(t)
377	            if c < st["best"].c - 0.01 and est_mod.plain_cost(self.case, t, st["std"]) < self.prep.c_alt:
378	                if best is None or c < best[1]:
379	                    best = (t, c)
380	        return best

382	    def realise(self, close, states, threads, sid):
383	        """A close rule as a decision: accept, walk, idle, or a one-off message written by code."""
384	        th = self.t.get(close.sid or sid)
385	        if close.kind == "accept":
386	            return {"supplier_id": close.sid, "reason": close.reason, "candidates": close.candidates,
387	                    "message": {"action": {"type": "accept", "term_sheet_id": close.sheet_id}}}  # fmt: skip
388	        if close.kind == "walk":
389	            return {"supplier_id": close.sid or sid, "message": {"action": {"type": "walk_away"}}}
390	        if close.kind == "idle":
391	            return {"supplier_id": sid, "idle": True}
392	        st = states[close.sid or sid]
393	        if close.kind == "offer_back":  # R12.13
394	            th.flags.add("earlier")
395	            t = complete(self.case, close.terms, st["std"])
396	            text = (
397	                f"Thank you. We have reviewed everything again and are ready to sign on your own earlier offer "
398	                f"{close.sheet_id} - the attached term sheet repeats exactly those terms. Can you confirm?"
399	            )
400	            return self.plain_message(threads, close.sid, [("their earlier offer", t)], text)
401	        if close.kind in ("repair", "restore"):  # R12.12 / R11.17: its price, must-haves kept, full need covered
402	            th.flags.add(close.kind)
403	            terms = close.terms or (st["best"].terms if st.get("best") else latest(st["events"]).get("term_sheets",
404	                                    [{}])[0].get("terms", {}))  # fmt: skip
405	            t = complete(self.case, sheets.repair(self.case, terms, st["std"]), st["std"])
406	            t = {**t, **self.full_cover(st, t)}
407	            if not st["ctx"].ok(t) or t.get("unit_price") is None:
408	                return None
409	            text = (f"Thank you - we accept your price of EUR {t['unit_price']:.2f}. To complete the agreement and "
410	                    "cover our full requirement, please confirm it on the attached term sheet; that is all we need "
411	                    "to sign.")  # fmt: skip
412	            return self.plain_message(threads, close.sid, [("confirm", t)], text)
413	        if close.kind == "lock_in":
414	            th.flags.add("lock")
415	            return self.plain_message(threads, close.sid, [("their prose offer", close.terms)],
416	                                      "Thank you - we take up the offer you described in your e-mail, as set out on "
417	                                      "the attached term sheet. Please confirm.")  # fmt: skip
418	        if close.kind == "repeat":
419	            return self.plain_message(
420	                threads, close.sid, th.last_sheets, "Thank you for your reply. Our offer stands as set out below."
421	            )
422	        return None

424	    def full_cover(self, st, terms):
425	        """The coverage options that cover the whole need over the horizon (R12.12, R11.17)."""
426	        b = self.case["buyer"]
427	        out = {}
428	        for f in COVERAGE:
429	            opts = (self.case.get("term_options") or {}).get(f) or []
430	            if f not in self.case["negotiable"] or not opts:
431	                continue
432	            need = b["need_per_year"] if f == "volume_per_year" else 12 * b["horizon_years"]
433	            enough = [o for o in opts if isinstance(o, int | float) and o >= need - 1e-9]
434	            out[f] = min(enough) if enough else max(opts)
435	        return out

437	    def plan_move(self, states, views, threads, sid):
438	        """The sheets of our next offer: a step on the next heavy term, else a price round; guarded."""
439	        st, th = states[sid], self.t[sid]
440	        ctx, base, target, info = st["ctx"], st["base"], st["target"], dict(st["info"])
441	        floor_p = sheets.floor(ctx)
442	        asks = self.asks(st)
443	        hold = info.get("kind") == "hold"
444	        cover_values = {f: base[f] for f in COVERAGE if f in base and f in self.case["negotiable"]}
445	        supplier_terms = [r.terms for r in st["rows"]]
446	
447	        def guarded_build(c_target):
448	            out, kind, fld = self.build(st, base, c_target, floor_p, asks)
449	
450	            def guard_menu(menu):
451	                menu = sheets.lock_coverage(ctx, menu, cover_values)
452	                slack = STEP_SLACK if kind == "step" else 0.0
453	                menu = sheets.guard(ctx, menu, c_target, supplier_terms, th.last_sheets, slack)
454	                return sheets.no_regress(ctx, menu, [r.c for r in st["rows"] if r.valid])
455	
456	            out = guard_menu(out)
457	            while kind == "step" and len({key(t.get(fld)) for _, t in out}) < 2:
458	                # The final guards can remove a choice too: record only the menu actually sent.
459	                th.steps.skipped.add(fld)
460	                out, kind, fld = self.build(st, base, c_target, floor_p, asks)
461	                out = guard_menu(out)
462	            return out, kind, fld
463	
464	        built = guarded_build(target)
465	        if hold and repeats([t for _, t in built[0]], [t for _, t in th.last_sheets]):
466	            # R5.3 + R13.7: a hold that would only repeat our sheets becomes the deadlock-breaking step
467	            target = th.plan.breaker(st["c_ref"])
468	            info["kind"], hold = "deadlock breaker (no repeat)", False
469	            built = guarded_build(target)
470	        out, kind, fld = built
471	        if (not out or repeats([t for _, t in out], [t for _, t in th.last_sheets])) and not hold:
472	            # nothing new at this target: one real step instead (R5.3) before the thread counts as done
473	            target = max(target, th.plan.breaker(st["c_ref"]))
474	            info["kind"] = "deadlock breaker (nothing new)"
475	            out, kind, fld = guarded_build(target)
476	        if not out or repeats([t for _, t in out], [t for _, t in th.last_sheets]):  # R12.10 / R13.7
477	            v = views[sid]
478	            if (r := closing.earlier_cheaper(v)) is not None:
479	                return self.realise(closing.Close("offer_back", "nothing new to offer: its earlier offer", sid, r.id,
480	                                                  terms=r.terms), states, threads, sid)  # fmt: skip
481	            if len(views) == 1 and (acc := closing.accept(views, "nothing new to offer")):
482	                return self.realise(acc, states, threads, sid)  # R13.7: the thread is done - close
483	            if len(views) > 1:
484	                return {"supplier_id": sid, "idle": True}  # RFQ: leave this thread, the others go on
485	            if not out:
486	                out = th.last_sheets or sheets.out_of_reach(ctx, base, floor_p) or sheets.just_under(ctx, base)
487	        lock = self.lock_in(st)
488	        pressure = st["left"] <= PRESSURE_LEFT or st["intel"].walk_risk >= LOCK_RISK or self.clock.near_end()
489	        if lock and (pressure or lock[1] <= target * (1 + LOCK_TOL)):
490	            if all((lock[0].get(f) or 0) >= v for f, v in cover_values.items() if isinstance(v, int | float)):
491	                out = [("their prose offer", lock[0]), *[(lb, t) for lb, t in out if t != lock[0]]]
492	                th.flags.add("lock")
493	        out = out[:3]
494	        return {"sheets": out, "kind": kind, "field": fld, "target": target, "info": info, "hold": hold,
495	                "lock": bool(lock and out and out[0][0] == "their prose offer"), "asks": asks}  # fmt: skip

497	    def build(self, st, base, target, floor_p, asks):
498	        th, ctx = self.t[st["sid"]], st["ctx"]
499	        locked = st["locked"]
500	        fld = th.steps.next_field(ctx, base, locked, list(asks))
501	        while fld is not None:
502	            pk = th.steps.packages(ctx, fld, base, target, floor_p, asked=asks.get(fld))
503	            if pk:
504	                return pk, "step", fld
505	            th.steps.skipped.add(fld)  # R13.4: no choice, no step - the term goes to the price round
506	            fld = th.steps.next_field(ctx, base, locked, list(asks))
507	        open_fields = [f for f in (th.steps.order or []) if f not in locked]
508	        profile = self.profiles.get(st["sid"], {})
509	        lv = [f for f in dict.fromkeys([*profile.get("levers", []), *self.prep.type_levers]) if f not in locked]
510	        price_asks = {f: v for f, v in asks.items() if f not in locked}
511	        out = sheets.price_sheets(ctx, base, target, lv, floor_p, open_fields, price_asks)
512	        if not th.plan.targets and out and len(out) < 3:  # R12.7: the first menu probes payment days
513	            if not any(t.get("payment_days") != out[0][1].get("payment_days") for _, t in out):
514	                if probe := sheets.payment_probe(ctx, out[0][1], target, floor_p, st["slopes"]):
515	                    out.append(("payment probe", probe))
516	        if len(out) < 3 and (iv := sheets.index_variant(ctx, out[0][1] if out else base, target, floor_p)):
517	            out.append(("their index clause", iv))  # R12.8
518	        if not out:
519	            out = sheets.out_of_reach(ctx, base, floor_p)  # R6.6
520	        return out, "price", None

522	    def asks(self, st):
523	        """R11.7: what the supplier asked for beyond our reference terms - in its sheet, or in its e-mail
524	        (the analyst's lever hints, snapped to the case's options) - when it costs us something."""
525	        ctx, base = st["ctx"], st["base"]
526	        price = ctx.their_price
527	        theirs = sheets.mutual_combo(ctx, ctx.their, price)
528	        ref = sheets.reference_combo(ctx, theirs, price)
529	        out = {f: theirs[f] for f in sheets.REFERENCE_FIELDS if f in theirs and key(theirs[f]) != key(ref.get(f))
530	               and f not in COVERAGE and f not in st["locked"]}  # fmt: skip
531	        opts = self.case.get("term_options") or {}
532	        for h in st["intel"].lever_hints:
533	            f = h.get("field")
534	            if (
535	                f in out
536	                or f not in self.case["negotiable"]
537	                or f == "unit_price"
538	                or not opts.get(f)
539	                or f in st["locked"]
540	            ):
541	                continue
542	            if not all(isinstance(o, int | float) for o in opts[f]):
543	                continue
544	            nums = [float(n.replace(",", ".")) for n in re.findall(r"\d+(?:[.,]\d+)?", h.get("hint") or "")]
545	            nums = [n for n in nums if min(opts[f]) * 0.5 <= n <= max(opts[f]) * 1.5]
546	            if nums:
547	                v = min(opts[f], key=lambda o: abs(o - nums[0]))
548	                worse = ctx.c({**base, f: v, "unit_price": price}) > ctx.c({**base, "unit_price": price})
549	                if worse and ctx.ok({**base, f: v}):
550	                    out[f] = v
551	        return out

554	    def arguments(self, states, threads, sid):
555	        """R9.5: checked arguments not cited yet, never one that came back contradicted, ranked by the
556	        profile's claim ranking, then strength."""
557	        st = states[sid]
558	        rivals = {}
559	        for s in live_threads(threads):
560	            if s != sid and (b := self._best_valid(threads, s)) and b.id:
561	                rivals[b.id] = b.terms["unit_price"]
562	        try:
563	            found = cl.candidates(self.package, self.case, sid, st["ctx"].their_price, rivals)
564	        except Exception as e:
565	            log.warning("arguments failed: %s", e)
566	            found = []
567	        keys = {a.key for a in found}
568	        found += [c for c in st["intel"].new_claims if c.key not in keys]
569	        ranking = self.profiles.get(sid, {}).get("claim_ranking") or []
570	        args = [a for a in cl.usable(found, self.ledger, sid) if self.results.get(a.key) != "contradicted"]
571	        args.sort(key=lambda a: (ranking.index(a.key) if a.key in ranking else len(ranking), -a.strength))
572	        return args

"""When to close (section 7), the accept ladder (R12.11) and the close guards of DualAgent and
TeamAgent (R11.17-R11.18, R12.12-R12.13, R12.15, R13.13). Pure functions over `View`s - one per live
supplier thread - so the rules are testable on recorded negotiations without the arena.

Accept the cheapest sheet that keeps the must-haves and beats the alternative when the supplier
agreed (R7.1), made a final offer (R7.2), its offer meets our next target - unless it is still
moving with more than 3 rounds left (R7.3) - its offer is as good as what we last offered (R7.4), at
most one round is left (R7.5), or the planned rounds are over (R7.6). Walk away only when nothing on
the table is acceptable and every thread is at a final offer or out of rounds. No deadlock close and
no walk-risk close.
"""

from dataclasses import dataclass, field

EARLIER_SHARE = 0.001  # R12.11: earlier IDs cheaper by 0.1 %+ go before the latest ones
MAX_EARLIER = 3
REVISIT_SHARE = 0.003  # R12.13: an earlier sheet 0.3 % cheaper is offered back once
COVERAGE_SHARE = 0.01  # R11.17: uncovered need over 1 % of C never "meets our target"
TARGET_TOL = 0.002  # R7.3
LAST_TOL = 0.001  # R7.4
MOVING_ROUNDS = 3  # R5.4 / R7.3
HOPELESS_SHARE, HOPELESS_MOVE = 0.08, 0.01  # R12.15
DEAR_SHARE = 0.25  # R8.2
STALL_TOL = 0.001
LIMIT_SENT = 3  # a supplier at its limit after 3+ of our offers: take its best offer before it walks
LIMIT_STEP = 0.005  # ... when its last step was under 0.5 % of C
WALK_CLOSE = 0.6  # ... or when its walk risk (R11.5) is this high
AGREE_GAP = 0.02  # it asks to close and is within 2 % of our next target: take it


@dataclass
class Row:
    """One sheet the supplier put on the table: a main sheet or an alternative."""

    id: str
    terms: dict
    c: float  # our C with the margin charge where the goal has one
    valid: bool  # keeps the must-haves and beats the alternative
    latest: bool  # in its latest e-mail
    main: bool = True
    reply: int = 0  # which of its replies (0 = the opening)
    uncovered: float = 0.0  # EUR of uncovered need (and its risk) in C


@dataclass
class View:
    """One live supplier thread, as the close rules see it."""

    sid: str
    status: str | None
    left: int  # messages we may still send
    sent: int  # our messages that reached it
    rows: list = field(default_factory=list)
    target: float | None = None  # our next target C
    last_target: float | None = None  # the target of our last offer
    moving: bool = False  # still conceding more than 0.4 % of C (R5.4)
    only_price: bool = False  # every step term settled (R13.13)
    planned_over: bool = False  # H + 2 offers made (R7.6)
    close_gap: float = 0.005
    replies_c: list = field(default_factory=list)  # C of its best sheet per reply, oldest first

input.content:
"""The lab: play strategy variants on the practice cases, keep every game in the experiment sheet, and
learn from it which strategy to play on a new case.

    # experiments: every variant on every hosted practice case (code-only: no model credits)
    python -m arena_kit.spec.lab run --variants base soft_anchor deep_anchor --parallel 8 --label sweep-1
    # the learned playbook's own pick per case; --holdout ignores the case's own games (an unseen case)
    python -m arena_kit.spec.lab learned --holdout --label holdout-1
    # rebuild the sheet and the playbook from the games recorded so far (run/learned do it at the end)
    python -m arena_kit.spec.lab build

Files (all in `knowledge/`, committed so the next session and the final start from them):

    experiments.jsonl      the experiment sheet: one line per game - case, features, variant, knobs, mode,
                           score, deal, costs, rounds, source fingerprint
    experiments.csv        the same as a table
    learned_playbook.json  per practice case: its features, base score and every variant's gain over base
                           - what `spec.strategy.choose` reads when the agent prepares a case
    EXPERIMENTS.md         the result sheet: hypotheses, the score grid, gains by goal and type, what the
                           playbook picks per case, every batch

Full sessions, threads and agent logs of every game go to `runs/lab/<batch>/`. Each hosted game uses one
practice session of the team's quota; the arena allows one open session per case, so a case's games
run one after another and different cases run in parallel.
"""

import argparse
import csv
import hashlib
import json
import logging
import os
import statistics
import subprocess
import threading
import time
from collections import defaultdict
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
from pathlib import Path

from ..agents.spec import SpecAgent, make
from ..cli import load_env
from ..client import ArenaClient
from ..data import DataPackage
from ..play import RemoteTable, hosted, play, quota_used_up
from . import strategy as strat
from .evaluate import audit, write_json

log = logging.getLogger("arena")
KIT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
SHEET = "experiments.jsonl"
_write = threading.Lock()


def source_fingerprint():
    files = sorted((KIT / "arena_kit").rglob("*.py"))
    return hashlib.sha256(b"".join(str(p.relative_to(KIT)).encode() + p.read_bytes() for p in files)).hexdigest()[:12]


def git_head():
    try:
        return subprocess.check_output(["git", "rev-parse", "--short", "HEAD"], text=True, cwd=KIT).strip()
    except Exception:
        return None


def read_sheet(kdir):
    path = Path(kdir) / SHEET
    if not path.exists():
        return []
    return [json.loads(line) for line in path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines() if line.strip()]


def append_row(kdir, row):
    with _write:
        Path(kdir).mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        with open(Path(kdir) / SHEET, "a", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            f.write(json.dumps(row, ensure_ascii=False, default=str) + "\n")


# --- playing -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def play_one(client, case, package, out, kdir, meta, name=None, model=False, kb=None, holdout=False):
    """One game of `case`: variant `name`, or (name None) the learned playbook's pick. One sheet row."""
    cid = case["case_id"]
    if name is None:
        s, picked, why = strat.choose(case, kb, exclude_self=holdout)
        chosen_by = "holdout" if holdout else "learned"
    else:
        s, picked, why, chosen_by = strat.variant(name), name, "fixed for this run", "fixed"
    log_dir = out / "logs"
    agent = make(package, strategy=s) if model else SpecAgent(package=package, log_dir=log_dir, strategy=s)
    agent.log_dir = log_dir
    table = RemoteTable(client, case)
    started = time.monotonic()
    record = {"case_id": cid, "variant": picked, "chosen_by": chosen_by, "why": why, "knobs": s.knobs()}
    try:
        result = play(table, cid, agent)
        record.update(result=result, session_id=table.session_id)
        if table.session_id:
            threads = {sid: client.thread(table.session_id, sid) for sid in case["suppliers"]}
            record.update(threads=threads, audit=audit(threads))
    except Exception as e:
        record.update(error=f"{type(e).__name__}: {e}", session_id=table.session_id)
        log.exception("%s %s failed", cid, picked)
        if quota_used_up(e):
            record["quota"] = True
    finally:
        agent.pool.shutdown(wait=False, cancel_futures=True)
    record["wall_s"] = round(time.monotonic() - started, 1)
    stem = f"{cid.split(':')[-1]}__{picked}__{chosen_by}"
    path = out / f"{stem}.json"
    n = 2
    while path.exists():
        path, n = out / f"{stem}_{n}.json", n + 1
    write_json(path, record)
    r = record.get("result") or {}
    buyer_msgs = sum(1 for t in (record.get("threads") or {}).values() for m in t.get("messages", [])
                     if m.get("from") == "buyer")  # fmt: skip
    row = {**meta, "t": time.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S"), **strat.features(case), "case_id": cid,
           "n_suppliers": len(case.get("suppliers") or []), "variant": picked, "chosen_by": chosen_by, "why": why,
           "knobs": s.knobs(), "mode": "model" if model else "code", "score": r.get("score"), "deal": r.get("deal"),
           "supplier_id": r.get("supplier_id"), "c_open": r.get("c_open"), "c_deal": r.get("c_deal"),
           "c_best": r.get("c_best"), "c_alt": r.get("c_alt"), "end_reason": r.get("end_reason"),
           "terms": r.get("terms"), "buyer_messages": buyer_msgs, "wall_s": record["wall_s"],
           "session_id": record.get("session_id"), "error": record.get("error"),
           "contradicted": len((record.get("audit") or {}).get("contradicted") or []),
           "timeouts": len((record.get("audit") or {}).get("timeouts") or []),
           "record": str(path.relative_to(KIT)) if path.is_relative_to(KIT) else str(path)}  # fmt: skip
    if not record.get("quota"):
        append_row(kdir, row)
    print(f"{cid} {picked:<13} ({chosen_by}) score={r.get('score')} deal={r.get('deal')} "
          f"wall={record['wall_s']}s error={record.get('error')}", flush=True)  # fmt: skip
    return row


def run_batch(client, cases, package, jobs, label, kdir, parallel=8, model=False, kb=None, holdout=False):
    """`jobs`: {case_id: [variant name or None (learned)]}. One thread per case runs its games in order,
    at most `parallel` games at once."""
    out = KIT / "runs" / "lab" / f"{time.strftime('%m%d-%H%M%S')}_{label}"
    out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
    meta = {"batch": out.name, "label": label, "git_head": git_head(), "source": source_fingerprint(),
            "model_name": os.environ.get("LLM_MODEL") if model else None}  # fmt: skip
    write_json(out / "metadata.json", {**meta, "jobs": jobs, "holdout": holdout})
    by_id = {c["case_id"]: c for c in cases}
    gate, stop, rows = threading.Semaphore(min(parallel, 10)), threading.Event(), []

    def case_chain(cid):
        for name in jobs[cid]:
            if stop.is_set():
                return
            with gate:
                row = play_one(client, by_id[cid], package, out, kdir, meta, name, model, kb, holdout)
            rows.append(row)
            if row.get("error") and "practice limit" in str(row["error"]):
                stop.set()

    with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=len(jobs)) as pool:
        for f in [pool.submit(case_chain, cid) for cid in jobs]:
            f.result()
    scores = [r["score"] for r in rows if r.get("score") is not None]
    print(f"batch {out.name}: {len(rows)} games, mean score {statistics.mean(scores) if scores else float('nan'):.4f}")
    return rows


# --- learning --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def usable(rows):
    return [r for r in rows if not r.get("error") and r.get("score") is not None and r.get("variant") in strat.VARIANTS]


def build_playbook(rows):
    """Per case: features, mean score per (mode, variant), and every variant's gain over base - measured
    within one mode (code-only or model) and averaged over the modes that have both."""
    rows = usable(rows)
    cells = defaultdict(list)
    for r in rows:
        cells[(r["case_id"], r["mode"], r["variant"])].append(r["score"])
    cases = {}
    for r in rows:
        cases.setdefault(r["case_id"], {"type": r.get("type"), "goal": r.get("goal"), "rfq": r.get("rfq"),
                                        "n_suppliers": r.get("n_suppliers"), "scores": {}, "gains": {}})  # fmt: skip
    for (cid, mode, name), scores in cells.items():
        cases[cid]["scores"].setdefault(mode, {})[name] = {"mean": round(statistics.mean(scores), 6),
                                                           "n": len(scores), "best": round(max(scores), 6)}  # fmt: skip
    for cid, e in cases.items():
        per = defaultdict(list)
        for mode, s in e["scores"].items():
            if "base" not in s:
                continue
            for name, v in s.items():
                if name != "base":
                    per[name].append((v["mean"] - s["base"]["mean"], v["n"]))
        e["gains"] = {name: {"gain": round(statistics.mean(g for g, _ in v), 6), "n": sum(n for _, n in v)}
                      for name, v in per.items()}  # fmt: skip
        base = [s["base"]["mean"] for s in e["scores"].values() if "base" in s]
        e["base"] = round(statistics.mean(base), 6) if base else None
    return {
        "built": time.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S"),
        "games": len(rows),
        "rules": {"min_gain": strat.MIN_GAIN, "max_loss": strat.MAX_LOSS},
        "variants": {n: {"knobs": v.knobs(), "hypothesis": strat.HYPOTHESES.get(n, "")}
                     for n, v in strat.VARIANTS.items()},  # fmt: skip
        "cases": dict(sorted(cases.items())),
    }


def _fmt(x, nd=3, sign=False):
    if x is None:
        return "—"
    return f"{x:+.{nd}f}" if sign else f"{x:.{nd}f}"


def report(kb, rows):
    """EXPERIMENTS.md: the result sheet."""
    ok = usable(rows)
    names = [n for n in strat.VARIANTS if any(r["variant"] == n for r in ok)]
    cases = kb["cases"]
    modes = sorted({r["mode"] for r in ok})
    lines = [
        "# SpecAgent experiment and result sheet",
        "",
        f"Built {kb['built']} from **{len(ok)} games** ({len(rows) - len(ok)} failed or unscored rows left out)"
        f" on {len(cases)} practice cases, modes: {', '.join(modes) or '—'}. Regenerate with"
        " `python -m arena_kit.spec.lab build`; every game is a line of `experiments.jsonl`, its full session in"
        " the `record` path. The agent reads `learned_playbook.json` when it prepares a case"
        " (`spec.strategy.choose`).",
        "",
        f"Rule: a variant replaces base for a group of cases when its mean score gain over base is at least"
        f" {strat.MIN_GAIN} and it lost no case in the group by more than {strat.MAX_LOSS}. Code-only games repeat"
        " almost exactly (same e-mails, same supplier replies), so one code-only game per case and variant is a"
        " measurement, not a sample; games with the model vary and are averaged.",
        "",
        "## Hypotheses and verdicts",
        "",
        "| Variant | Knobs vs base | Hypothesis | Cases | Mean gain | Won / lost | Verdict |",
        "|---|---|---|---:|---:|---|---|",
    ]
    all_gains = strat.gains(cases.values())
    for n in strat.VARIANTS:
        g = all_gains.get(n, [])
        if n == "base":
            lines.append(f"| base | — | {strat.HYPOTHESES['base']} | {sum(1 for e in cases.values() if e['base'] is not None)}"
                         " | — | — | control |")  # fmt: skip
            continue
        won, lost = sum(x > 0.001 for x in g), sum(x < -0.001 for x in g)
        if not g:
            verdict = "not tested yet"
        elif statistics.mean(g) >= strat.MIN_GAIN and min(g) >= -strat.MAX_LOSS:
            verdict = "better overall"
        elif won:
            verdict = "helps some cases only"
        else:
            verdict = "rejected"
        lines.append(f"| {n} | {strat.describe(strat.VARIANTS[n])} | {strat.HYPOTHESES.get(n, '')} | {len(g)} | "
                     f"{_fmt(statistics.mean(g) if g else None, sign=True)} | {won} / {lost} | {verdict} |")  # fmt: skip
    for mode in modes:
        lines += ["", f"## Score per case and variant ({mode})", "",
                  "Mean score (games); **bold** = best for the case.", "",
                  "| Case | Type / goal | " + " | ".join(names) + " |",
                  "|---|---|" + "---:|" * len(names)]  # fmt: skip
        for cid, e in cases.items():
            s = e["scores"].get(mode, {})
            if not s:
                continue
            top = max(v["mean"] for v in s.values())
            cells = []
            for n in names:
                v = s.get(n)
                cell = "—" if v is None else f"{v['mean']:.3f} ({v['n']})"
                cells.append(f"**{cell}**" if v is not None and v["mean"] == top else cell)
            lines.append(f"| {cid} | {e['type']} / {e['goal']}{' RFQ' if e['rfq'] else ''} | " + " | ".join(cells) + " |")
        means = []
        for n in names:
            vals = [e["scores"][mode][n]["mean"] for e in cases.values() if n in e["scores"].get(mode, {})]
            means.append(f"{statistics.mean(vals):.3f}" if vals else "—")
        lines.append("| **mean** | | " + " | ".join(means) + " |")
    lines += ["", "## Gain over base by group", "",
              "| Group | Cases | Best variant | Its mean gain | All variants (mean gain) |", "|---|---:|---|---:|---|"]  # fmt: skip
    groups = defaultdict(list)
    for cid, e in cases.items():
        groups[f"goal {e['goal']}"].append(e)
        groups[f"type {e['type']}"].append(e)
        groups[f"{e['type']} / {e['goal']}"].append(e)
    for label in sorted(groups):
        es = groups[label]
        got = strat.best_of(es)
        g = strat.gains(es)
        detail = ", ".join(f"{n} {statistics.mean(v):+.3f}" for n, v in sorted(g.items(), key=lambda x: -statistics.mean(x[1])))
        lines.append(f"| {label} | {len(es)} | {got[0] if got else '—'} | {_fmt(got[1] if got else None, sign=True)} | "
                     f"{detail or '—'} |")  # fmt: skip
    lines += ["", "## What the agent will play", "",
              "`learned`: the pick for this practice case; `unseen`: the pick if the case were new (its own games"
              " left out) - what a hidden case of the same kind gets.", "",
              "| Case | Base score | Learned pick | Why | Unseen pick | Why |", "|---|---:|---|---|---|---|"]  # fmt: skip
    for cid, e in cases.items():
        case = {"case_id": cid, "type": e["type"], "buyer": {"category_goal": e["goal"]},
                "suppliers": [None] * (e.get("n_suppliers") or 1)}  # fmt: skip
        _, n1, w1 = strat.choose(case, kb)
        _, n2, w2 = strat.choose(case, kb, exclude_self=True)
        lines.append(f"| {cid} | {_fmt(e['base'])} | {n1} | {w1} | {n2} | {w2} |")
    lessons = learned_lessons(kb)
    if lessons:
        lines += ["", "## Lessons", "", *[f"- {x}" for x in lessons]]
    lines += ["", "## Batches", "", "| Batch | Label | Mode | Games | Mean score | Source |", "|---|---|---|---:|---:|---|"]
    by_batch = defaultdict(list)
    for r in rows:
        by_batch[r.get("batch")].append(r)
    for b, rs in sorted(by_batch.items(), key=lambda x: str(x[0])):
        sc = [r["score"] for r in rs if r.get("score") is not None]
        lines.append(f"| {b} | {rs[0].get('label')} | {rs[0].get('mode')} | {len(rs)} | "
                     f"{_fmt(statistics.mean(sc) if sc else None)} | {rs[0].get('source')} |")  # fmt: skip
    return "\n".join(lines) + "\n"


def learned_lessons(kb):
    """Plain sentences from the gains: which variant helps or hurts which goal."""
    out = []
    by_goal = defaultdict(list)
    for e in kb["cases"].values():
        by_goal[e["goal"]].append(e)
    for goal, es in sorted(by_goal.items()):
        g = strat.gains(es)
        for n, v in sorted(g.items(), key=lambda x: -statistics.mean(x[1])):
            m = statistics.mean(v)
            if m >= strat.MIN_GAIN:
                out.append(f"{goal}: **{n}** helped ({m:+.3f} on average, better in {sum(x > 0.001 for x in v)}"
                           f" of {len(v)} case{'s' if len(v) != 1 else ''}).")  # fmt: skip
            elif m <= -0.02:
                out.append(f"{goal}: {n} hurt ({m:+.3f} on average) - avoid.")
    return out


def build(kdir):
    rows = read_sheet(kdir)
    kb = build_playbook(rows)
    kdir = Path(kdir)
    write_json(kdir / strat.PLAYBOOK_FILE, kb)
    (kdir / "EXPERIMENTS.md").write_text(report(kb, rows), encoding="utf-8")
    keys = ["batch", "label", "t", "case_id", "type", "goal", "rfq", "variant", "chosen_by", "mode", "score", "deal",
            "supplier_id", "c_open", "c_deal", "c_best", "c_alt", "buyer_messages", "wall_s", "end_reason",
            "contradicted", "timeouts", "error", "source", "session_id", "record"]  # fmt: skip
    with open(kdir / "experiments.csv", "w", newline="", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        w = csv.DictWriter(f, fieldnames=keys + list(strat.BASE.knobs()), extrasaction="ignore")
        w.writeheader()
        for r in rows:
            w.writerow({**r, **(r.get("knobs") or {})})
    print(f"learned playbook: {len(kb['cases'])} cases from {kb['games']} games -> {kdir}")
    return kb


# --- command line ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def main():
    load_env()
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__, formatter_class=argparse.RawDescriptionHelpFormatter)
    ap.add_argument("command", choices=["run", "learned", "build"])
    ap.add_argument("--variants", nargs="*", default=list(strat.VARIANTS), help="run: the variants to play")
    ap.add_argument("--ids", nargs="*", help="cases (P01 ...); default every hosted practice case")
    ap.add_argument("--repeat", type=int, default=1, help="games per case and variant")
    ap.add_argument("--parallel", type=int, default=8)
    ap.add_argument("--model", action="store_true", help="the model writes and reads e-mails (costs credits)")
    ap.add_argument("--holdout", action="store_true", help="learned: ignore each case's own games")
    ap.add_argument("--label", default="lab")
    ap.add_argument("--knowledge", type=Path, default=strat.KNOWLEDGE_DIR)
    args = ap.parse_args()
    logging.basicConfig(level=logging.WARNING, format="%(asctime)s %(message)s")
    if args.command == "build":
        build(args.knowledge)
        return
    for n in args.variants:
        strat.variant(n)
    package = DataPackage(os.environ.get("ARENA_DATA", "data/package"))
    package.lookup("")
    client = ArenaClient()
    cases = hosted(client.cases("practice"))
    if args.ids:
        ids = {i if i.startswith("case:") else f"case:{i}" for i in args.ids}
        cases = [c for c in cases if c["case_id"] in ids]
    kb = strat.load(args.knowledge / strat.PLAYBOOK_FILE) if args.command == "learned" else None
    per_case = (args.variants if args.command == "run" else [None]) * args.repeat
    jobs = {c["case_id"]: list(per_case) for c in cases}
    planned = sum(len(v) for v in jobs.values())
    left = (client.me().get("practice") or {}).get("left")
    print(json.dumps({"planned_games": planned, "quota_left": left}), flush=True)
    if left is not None and planned > left:
        raise SystemExit(f"{planned} games planned but only {left} practice sessions left")
    run_batch(client, cases, package, jobs, args.label, args.knowledge, args.parallel, args.model, kb, args.holdout)
    build(args.knowledge)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Strategy knobs, the learned playbook and how the agent picks a strategy for a case."""

import json

import pytest

from arena_kit.spec import lab, playbook, prep
from arena_kit.spec import strategy as strat
from arena_kit.spec.concession import Plan
from tests.spec_support import CASES


def row(case_id, variant, score, mode="code", type_="raw_material", goal="leverage", n=1, **kw):
    return {"case_id": case_id, "variant": variant, "score": score, "mode": mode, "type": type_, "goal": goal,
            "rfq": n > 1, "n_suppliers": n, "batch": "b", "label": "t", **kw}  # fmt: skip


def case(case_id, type_="raw_material", goal="leverage", n=1):
    return {"case_id": case_id, "type": type_, "buyer": {"category_goal": goal}, "suppliers": [f"s{i}" for i in range(n)]}


def test_base_strategy_leaves_the_playbook_unchanged():
    c = CASES["case:P01"]

def test_variant_changes_anchor_cut_close_gap_and_horizon():
    c = CASES["case:P18"]
    s = strat.Strategy(cut_k=2.0, close_gap_k=3.0, horizon_delta=-10, anchor_cost_k=0.9)
    r = s.row(c)
    assert r["cut"] == pytest.approx(2 * playbook.row(c)["cut"])
    assert r["close_gap"] == pytest.approx(3 * playbook.row(c)["close_gap"])
    assert r["anchor_cost_k"] == 0.9
    assert s.horizon(c) == strat.MIN_HORIZON
    assert prep.prepare(c, strategy=s).row["cut"] == pytest.approx(r["cut"])

    soft = prep.prepare(c, strategy=strat.VARIANTS["soft_anchor"])
    for sid, o in base.openings.items():

def test_concession_knobs_change_the_step():
    slow, fast = Plan(**strat.VARIANTS["slow_concede"].plan_kwargs()), Plan(**strat.VARIANTS["fast_concede"].plan_kwargs())
    for p in (slow, fast):
        p.set_anchor(900_000)
        p.observe(1_000_000, 1)
        p.commit(p.next_target(1_000_000, 6)[0])
        p.observe(990_000, 2)
    assert slow.next_target(990_000, 6)[0] < fast.next_target(990_000, 6)[0]

The SpecAgent's strategy knobs - anchor depth, concession pace, when to close - are tuned by experiment,
not by hand. `spec.lab` plays named variants (`arena_kit/spec/strategy.py`: `VARIANTS`, each with a
hypothesis) on the hosted practice cases and writes every game to the experiment sheet in
`knowledge/`. From it, it builds `knowledge/learned_playbook.json` and the result sheet
`knowledge/EXPERIMENTS.md`. When the agent prepares a case (`--agent spec`, `spec.evaluate`), it reads the
playbook and plays the variant with the best evidence. It looks for the same case first, then the same
type and goal, then the same goal, then the same type, and falls back to the defaults when nothing
comparable has been tested.

```bash
uv run python -m arena_kit.spec.lab run --parallel 8 --label sweep-2                # every variant x every case
uv run python -m arena_kit.spec.lab run --variants base deep_anchor --ids P05 P18   # a targeted test
```
